notes.title: Version 0.16.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed some of Billy Lee's moves
[*] Leaderboards for the wooden dummy and dagger targets - would be good to see some scores!
[*] Tidied up a few bits of scenery
[*] New bush rustle sound effect
[*] Can now have the VR hats higher via the options menu
[*] Fixed an issue with the bicep pressure point sound effect not playing at time of impact
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.16.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Custom Mode added - create a game with various options. If you want to play triple dragons, with 1 arm and 1000% health, you now can. Note: You cannot yet change the options after having started, but I intend to add that shortly
[*] Changes to numb arm and disabled arm effects
[*] High priest no longer has his skin turn black when using iron fists
[*] Vive cosmos should now hopefully work - let me know
[*] People should no longer get tangled up when getting up near the ropes in the boxing ring
[*] Other various fixes and tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.15.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] AI Adjusted - opponents should dither about less
[*] Arcade mode has a leaderboard now
[*] Some physics tweaks
[*] Shouldnt be able to hit the head down quite so much, was making them go a bit weird at times
[*] Adjusted lighting on shaolin temple
[*] Ninja challenge - ninjas health reduced a bit, to counter the recent overall increase in health. I want i so that you can 1 hit KO them if you get a good hit in
[*] Fixed some issues with hair and beards stretching sometimes
[*] A couple more pressure point sounds: Groin and biceps
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.15.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added some "head wobble" physics when you hit the head, see the head snap back, turn etc depending where you hit it
[*] Change the AI turning so that its smoother and they can turn quicker if you jump over them
[*] One armed mode - made the special move do extra damage and made the health/special meters float where your missing hand would be
[*] Hopefully/maybe fixed the issue with them sometimes getting stuck in the scenery when getting up
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.15.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] One Armed Boxer mode added
[*] Some scenery adjustments
[*] All fighters have a bit more health
[*] Easy mode slightly harder
[*] Other small adjustments and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.14.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You must now be whitelisted in order to play. If the game wont let you, then get in touch either via the Discord or by emailing: ben@benolding.co.uk
[*] More physics tweaks, hits should connect a bit more easily now
[*] AI tweaks to do with changing height,  but also if you get behind them they should move away. Also hopefully they are a bit less vulnerable at the start of a fight if you charge in
[*] More fighting moves for billy lee, ting an, dragon master, ling hou, fan lin
[/list]

notes.title: Version Beta 0.14.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improvements to physics
[*] Changes to AI, they will now change stance height, and will move to match yours in a bit more of a human like manner
[*] Added shoes to the monks and soldiers (+ peacock feathers to soldier hats - classy). + socks to several characters
[*] Changes to how some options work - if they have more than 3 settings then they will show a sub menu i.e. less pressing the same button again and again
[*] Possibly Got achievements working - although possibly not
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.13.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Achievements added
[*] Physics adjusted - less rubbery + less accidental hits
[*] More head hit sounds added + hit sounds for some pressure points: eye, ribs, knees
[*] New swoosh sound if striking with an open hand/chop, old sound is still there for punch
[*] New fighting moves added to Dragon Master, Ting An, Kuriyami, The tiger, ling hou and probably some others
[*] Few improvements to some scenery
[*] Can pick chinese text language from the options menu
[*] Reworked numb arm effect, bear strength and weakness
[*] Some new lighting on the general chamber, ninja camp, red flower cult and restaurant
[*] Bits of smashed table should no longer get in the way of you walking, so hopefully will make the restaurant a bit easier to move around
[*] Some AI tweaks
[*] Ip Ming-Yu should no longer get stuck in his special move pose
[*] Subtitles improved
[*] High score table should refresh now if you get a new highscore
[*] Character portraits on the floor glow as you approach
[*] Lots of other small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.12.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Some more physics adjustments that should affect easy/medium most of all, makes opponents weaker on those levels - I think the previous version made it a bit hard to block and/or trap
[*] Added options for adjusting trigger/grip sensitivity - might affect the defaults, let me know if its all gone wrong
[*] Added an option to adjust Mirror FOV i.e. the field of view on the screen (not headset). This could affect performance if above 60, but will probably be ok, let me know
[*] Optional subtitles added, switch them on in Options > Audio
[*] Some small fixes to characters & bios
[/list]

notes.title: Version Beta 0.11.2
notes.content:
Note to testers: please actually share your experience playing the game, even if all fine. There are lots of people just playing it and not saying a word to me - also can see from logs that players have encountered game breaking bugs and quit and not even bothered to tell me.

[list]
[*] Adjustments to physics to make things a bit less rubbery. Let me know if you notice/what you think
[*] Changes to AI to make them dash a bit less randomly
[*] Some behind the scenes changes todo with adding other language support later on - not visible yet, but might cause bugs
[*] Some behind the scenes changes todo with achievements - not visible yet, but might cause bugs
[*] Endurance Mode has been swapped for Arcade Mode. A little bit different to before - I was imagining this might be what you would play in a VR arcade
[*] New Stamina Mode - all fighters have 5x health meaning longer rounds
[*] More Character bios
[*] Some improvements to some scenery
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.11.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Multiple Save slots - let me know if you have any issues with these
[*] New Practice Mode: in the move practice room, can now switch to free practice mode which will tell you how much damage each move gets and what you hit, and will also show combos. The opponent will do various stances/guards and occasionally try and block/dodge/counter
[*] Billy Lee now has Fast Feet perk and Red Flower has First Strike + Billy's move charges up quicker
[*] More character bios
[*] Some other small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version Beta 0.10.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Opponents wont lower stance anymore and instead will kick you if you get too low - let me know if this is exploitable. They will also pick attacks based on height. This is bound to have issues with it, so let me know if any opponents act oddly e.g. never use their hands/only kick. I might make some characters still get lower, not sure
[*] Fix to dragon doubles mode so that they wont recharge health to max unless they've lost a life.
[*] Adjusted how AI aim their kicks
[*] Ninja Challenge hopefully has a leaderboard. Will add one to endurance also
[*] Couple more Bios
[*] More tweaks to difficulty
[/list]

notes.title: Version Beta 0.10.0
notes.content:
Thank you all for your feedback and videos. I have made some changes based on what you've done and told me, and will do more...

[list]
[*] New Special Mode: Dragon Doubles - for extra challenge fight 2 opponents each time (will overwrite main game)
[*] AI changes:
[*] Opponents now move about faster, in line with your speed, but will also vary their speed to make them less predictable. This is more in effect in the higher difficulties
[*] Opponents will now also "Dash" sometimes, darting in/out - But it still needs some improvement, makes them do some odd things sometimes
[*] Opponents will now "charge in" under certain conditions to take advantage, e.g. if you are blinded, or they have some effect
[*] Training chambers will lead on to starting a new game, if there isn't already one in progress
[*] Options > Testing - Can nmow switch "Always Meters" on, so that you can see the healthbars even in hard modes if you wish
[*] Options > Gameplay - Can now change AI speed (speed the AI does its attacks) and/or the timescale (affects speed of lots of things)
[*] Forearms now do a bit less damage
[*] Opponents/You will be knocked back a bit more easily if low on "stamina"
[*] Slow motion from big hits lasts less time as you go up the difficulty levels
[*] Some more fighter bios
[*] Added option: "None" to turning for if you just want to turn in your play space
[*] Fixes/tweaks to claytons Iron Fists special move
[*] Fixes to grabbing/throwing candles + they no longer persist on the floor when you change levels
[*] Pistol no longer auto drops after a few seconds (unless AI player)
[*] You will now get up quicker after knock out regardless if they have moved away or not
[*] Shouldn't be able to stand on fragments of smashed pots/boards any more
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adjustments to doors in training chambers to make it clearer which way to go
[*] Adjustment with physics to stop your hand getting stuck in the wing chun dummy (hopefully)
[*] Added button to options > Testing to allow you to see your activity log
[/list]
